review_samples.author: Mars Lusk
review_samples.text: Manuel is AWESOME!! Super grateful my dad found him through google reviews, this was easily the best detail i've ever had done on any car i've ever had! 100% worth the time and money, it looks better than it did off the lot! Thank you Manuel!!

review_samples.author: Fred DiNucci
review_samples.text: Brought my Lexus RX450H in to Fuster Mobile Car Detailing for the 1st time this morning and had Manuel clean it inside and out. His work is meticulous, spending more than an hour servicing my vehicle.

review_samples.author: STEVE James
review_samples.text: Manuel did an excellent job on my wife's Suburban and my Silverado. He was able to fit us in on a Saturday and we really appreciate it. Will be calling again for future detailing.

review_samples.author: Alia Swart
review_samples.text: Manuel made my mom's 2003 Toyota Corolla look amazing! I set a appointment through the phone and he arrived on time and was ready to work. He spent hours working on getting it all clean and polished. He is a complete professional and I highly recommend him.

review_samples.author: Mike Shane
review_samples.text: Extremely Pleased, Awesome Job!! Took my 2005 Honda Accord literally made her Beautiful!! Outside, Inside, Headlights, Carpets, Floor Mats, Leather Seats, Engine; All look young again!
